user.title: Daily Energy for Moj Elektro
user.description: Everything is fetched straight from the Moj Elektro API. Create the token at mojelektro.si under Moj profil > Kreiraj žeton (unlimited expiration). The meter ID is the EIMM number under Merilna mesta / merilne točke.

data_description.token: Stored in Home Assistant only; it never reaches the browser.
data_description.pin: If set, opening the manual meter reading and deleting data ask for it. Leave empty for no PIN.

error.invalid_auth: Moj Elektro did not accept this API token.
error.invalid_meter: Moj Elektro refused the request. Check the meter ID (EIMM) and that the token belongs to it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Moj Elektro API. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This meter already has a Daily Energy dashboard.

data.sidebar: Show Daily Energy in the sidebar

data_description.pin: Protects the manual meter reading and deleting data. Leave empty for no PIN.
data_description.token: Only if you created a new token in Moj Elektro. Leave empty to keep the current one.
